note: Local art models. Weights live under ComfyUI's models folder, never in this repository. Licences are what each publisher's Hugging Face or GitHub page declares; fetch_models.py refuses a Hub licence that changes.

models.why: Reference editing at full steps; the model to train a LoRA on
Z-Image base (Alibaba Tongyi lab): full, non-distilled text to image for previews and first drafts
The VAE ComfyUI's Z-Image template names
Upscaler for the private vanilla LoRA experiment
FLUX 3 Image Klein base. Gated, FLUX Kommunity License: the owner's decision, not part of the Apache pipeline
FLUX 3 Image Klein's text encoder (the model card lists it as Apache 2.0, inside the gated repository)

RefControl depth LoRA for FLUX.2 Klein 4B Base (thedeoxen): a depth map as the first reference, the design as the second, trigger word refcontrol; the camera-angle trial (docs/development/view-angle-models.md)

Stable Audio 3 Small SFX base (Stability AI; Stability AI Community License, which the Hub calls stable-audio-community): sound effects at full steps, the first sound engine, sa3-sfx-base. Outputs are ours and need no notice in a mod (docs/development/sound-generation.md)
Stable Audio 3 Small SFX distilled (same licence): the fast comparison, sa3-sfx
The text encoder every Stable Audio 3 model uses (same repository and licence)
Stable Audio 3 Medium base (9.2 GB, same licence): longer sounds and music; a comparison only, sa3-medium-base
Stable Audio 3 Medium distilled (9.2 GB, same licence): a comparison only, sa3-medium

BiRefNet (Zheng Peng and colleagues; ComfyUI's repackaged single file, 444 MB): finds which white in a picture is background, including background a shape encloses (the cargo hook's opening, owner, 12 Nov 2026). Runs on the processor beside the game
